fullPassage: The reality of economic relationships can be highly complex and may not even be fully observable, and it may even be impossible to estimate using the observed data. Hence, economists build a model - a simplified version of reality - that is simple enough to be mathematically and statistically tractable. The model enables economists to estimate the simplified relationship using the data, which sheds light on the reality of the relationship. The model can be regarded as an approximation of reality, and it is the hope of the economists that their model is a good approximation of the true relationship. As the famous statistician George Box stated in 1976, "all models are wrong, but some are useful." The statement means the model is an approximation, which can sometimes be a good representation of reality. In this case, the model can provide useful results about the relationship. However, often the model represents a poor approximation and may provide misleading conclusions about the relationship. In their training, economists learn how to employ various statistical methods to find a model that is a good approximation of reality. This discipline is called econometrics, which involves statistical and mathematical approaches to modeling economic relationships. A useful model is hard to get, but it provides interesting information from data and can be used by economists to make important predictions and policy decisions.

❌ ② valuable — 가치 있는 (동의 뉘앙스)

questions.passage:
(A) In economics, researchers build a simplified <u>model</u> of reality so that complex relationships become easier to estimate and analyze.

(B) The famous <u>model</u> posed for the photographer, wearing the newest dress from the designer's spring collection.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)와 (B)의 model의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 실제를 단순화한 '모형'(추상적 표현) / (B) 옷을 입고 포즈를 취하는 사람 '(패션)모델'
det.analysis:
❌ ① 모형 — 모형 (B는 사물 모형이 아닌 사람 '모델')
❌ ② 본보기 — (패션)모델 (A는 '본보기'가 아닌 단순화한 '모형')
✅ ③ 모형 — (패션)모델 ←정답
❌ ④ 규범 — (패션)모델 (A는 '규범'이 아닌 '모형')

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어는?

"a discipline that uses statistical and mathematical methods to study and model economic relationships"

det.korean: 통계적·수학적 방법으로 경제 관계를 연구하고 모형화하는 학문 → econometrics(계량경제학)
det.analysis:
❌ ① economics — 경제학 (더 넓은 분야)
❌ ② mathematics — 수학 (수단일 뿐)
❌ ③ statistics — 통계학 (수단일 뿐)
✅ ④ econometrics — 계량경제학 ←정답
det.tip: econometrics = 통계·수학으로 경제 관계를 모형화하는 학문(계량경제학)

questions.passage: Hence, economists build a model - a simplified version of reality - that is simple enough to be mathematically and statistically tractable. The model __________ (enable) economists to estimate the simplified relationship using the data.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: The model __________ (enable) → 주어가 3인칭 단수 The model, 현재시제 → enables

questions.passage: The model can be __________ (regard) as an approximation of reality, and it is the hope of the economists that their model is a good approximation of the true relationship.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: can be + 과거분사 = 수동태 → regard → regarded
det.analysis: The model can be __________ (regard) as ~ → 조동사+be 뒤 과거분사 자리(수동태) → regarded

questions.passage: The reality of economic relationships can be highly complex and may not even be fully observable, and it may even be impossible to estimate using the observed data. Hence, economists build a model - a simplified version of reality - that is simple enough to be mathematically and statistically tractable. The model enables economists to estimate the simplified relationship using the data, which sheds light on the reality of the relationship. The model can be regarded as an approximation of reality, and it is the hope of the economists that their model is a good approximation of the true relationship. As the famous statistician George Box stated in 1976, "all models are wrong, but some are useful." The statement means the model is an approximation, which can sometimes be a good representation of reality. In this case, the model can provide useful results about the relationship. However, often the model represents a poor approximation and may provide misleading conclusions about the relationship. In their training, economists learn how to employ various statistical methods to find a model that is a good approximation of reality. This discipline is called econometrics, which involves statistical and mathematical approaches to modeling economic relationships. A useful model is hard to get, but it provides interesting information from data and can be used by economists to __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 유용한 모형은 얻기 어렵지만 데이터로부터 흥미로운 정보를 주며, 경제학자가 '중요한 예측과 정책 결정을 내리는' 데 쓰일 수 있다는 맥락이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① hide the observed data — 관찰된 데이터를 숨김 (모형의 유용함과 반대)
✅ ② make important predictions and policy decisions — 중요한 예측·정책 결정 ←정답
❌ ③ replace every economic theory — 모든 경제 이론을 대체 (문맥 무관)
❌ ④ avoid all statistical methods — 모든 통계 방법을 회피 (본문과 반대)
det.tip: used by economists to make important predictions and policy decisions

ch: make important predictions and policy decisions

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: However(그러나)로 전환되어, 모형이 흔히 '형편없는 근사에 그쳐' 오해의 소지가 있는 결론을 준다는 맥락이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① represents a poor approximation — 형편없는 근사에 그침 ←정답
❌ ② reflects the exact truth — 정확한 진실을 반영 (misleading conclusions와 모순)
❌ ③ ignores all economic data — 모든 경제 데이터를 무시 (문맥 무관)
❌ ④ becomes a universal language — 보편 언어가 됨 (문맥 무관)
det.tip: However, often the model represents a poor approximation → misleading conclusions
